title: Beautiful Bamboo. Weak at the Edges.
text: Beautiful Bamboo. Weak at the Edges.. These bamboo organizers are really beautiful and make a nice addition to any room. The downside is that they're a bit overpriced and not all that sturdy. One of the four boxes came separated at the seem (where the company has glued the edges together). Seems like the other three are put together well, though, and the inner plastic cups/liners make it them easy to clean.

product_metadata.title: Multi-Function Bamboo Box Set of 4 - Thomas Grace Homewares. Kitchen Utensil Holder for Countertop | Bathroom Caddy Organizer | Pencil Holder | with Internal Moisture Guard (2 x box sizes inside)
features: EASY TO CLEAN UTENSIL HOLDER OR BATHROOM CADDY that combines elegance with hygiene in perfect harmony…Whilst other cooking utensil holders or bathroom caddies can quickly show mold if they get wet inside, our unique design provides moisture protection to the inside of the bamboo box. DO NOT USE BOXES TO HOLD LIQUID. Remove internal plastic box and dry thoroughly before returning inside bamboo box.

4 x BAMBOO BOXES IN EACH SET !! .. 2 large boxes + 2 medium boxes + BONUS matching internal plastic boxes in each set… That’s 8 storage containers for organizing.…Dimensions are: 2 x Tall box: 4.31" x 4.31" x 5.94” H .…. 2 x medium box: 3.38" x 3.38" x 4.81" H…. While the internal box protects the bamboo box from sharp or wet objects like cutlery, they can also be removed and used separately as clear craft storage.

PERFECT FOR OUTDOORS – STRONG & STURDY WOODEN UTENSIL CADDY HOLDER ideal for BBQ or parties and won’t break like ceramic utensil crocks. Suitable for travel in motor homes, caravan or boat. Utensil organizer for larger cooking utensils or flatware suits the 2 x large boxes. Also items like hair brush, toothbrush, shaver, shaving oils, scissors. Medium Boxes ideal for a desk organizer, pen holder, pencil holder rulers, markers.

ORGANIZE YOUR KITCHEN COUNTERTOP READY FOR ACTION and stop wasting time fumbling in drawers for that spatula, wooden spoon, whisks or chop stick. Bathroom organizer countertop boxes as toothbrush holders, hair brush & makeup brush holders, shavers & oils & vanity organizer. It won’t matter if they are wet as the internal plastic box protects the bamboo from any little spill.

NO TOOLS OR INSTALLATION REQUIRED.. 100% NATURAL ECO-FRIENDLY BAMBOO boxes. Arrive fully assembled and ready to go out of the box. Two sizes to cater for large or small items. Ideal wooden pencil holder for student study desk homework or office, or your sunglasses’ & key organizer by the front door. Internal plastic box protects the bamboo and are removable for cleaning so you can use in the kitchen & bathroom where items may be wet.
